Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and collect stones. One day, she found a pretty stone and put it in her pocket. 

As she was walking, she saw a big dog. The dog barked at her and Lily thought it was a toy. She picked it up and realized that the stone was a toy dog. 

"Hey, dog!" said Lily. "Give it back!" She pulled the dog's stone back, but this time it didn't move. She smiled and continued her search for more stones.
